extracted.name: Savory Vegetable Stir-Fry
extracted.description: Yellow squash, zucchini, carrots and red onion combine to make this sassy stir-fried side dish that's ready in just 20 minutes!
ingredient_lines: 1 medium red onion, cut in half and thickly sliced
2 packets Swanson® Flavor Boost™ Concentrated Vegetable Broth
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the yellow squash, zucchini, carrots, and onion and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Stir the concentrated broth in the skillet and cook until the mixture is hot.
